title: Tangent fermions can restore vacuum stability of discrete-time Dirac models
summary: The Dirac quantum walk (a 1+1 dimensional space-time discretization of the Dirac equation) has a $2μ$ mass gap both at the center and at the corner of the quasi-energy-momentum Brillouin zone. Gupta and Short recently noted [Quantum 9, 1845 (2025)] that the Dirac vacuum can create a particle-hole pair at the zone corner with the release of an energy $2μ$ to the environment. They removed this vacuum instability at the expense of fermion doubling, the appearance of a second low-energy Dirac cone.
